title: FIRE HAZARDS
why: His yes to fire as a hazard that makes spots impassable, not coming in from the map edges. Every raid now plans two fuel fires out on open ground, away from where you drop and from the extraction rings. A fire smoulders for four seconds (a dashed ring on the ground and FUEL FIRE in the alert with the distance and direction), then burns for 55 seconds as a disc of flame about as wide as a house. While it burns nobody can walk through it: you, the machines and the pillagers are all stopped at its edge, and standing at the edge burns you (the machines burn faster). Bullets fly over it. The Director never lands a pack inside one. It dies down to embers, and it shows as a mark on the minimap and the sector map. DEMO and CAREER work the same, and the fire is a single call (fireAdd) so the coming raid events can start fires of their own.
now: Two fuel fires per raid burn as impassable discs of flame that stop and burn anyone at their edge.
